notes: The player is addressed only with polite forms (ይገንቡ, ያሻሽሉ, መንደርዎ); masculine or feminine singular imperatives (ገንባ/ገንቢ) are not used, and players or {name} in the third person take plural/honorific verbs (ተቀላቅለዋል), which state no gender.

No preposition (የ, በ, ለ, ከ) or suffix (-ን) is attached to a placeholder or #: a colon (ዝግጁ፦ {building}) or a noun beside the placeholder carries it. Where the English itself glues a fragment placeholder to a word (message{arg1}), the same position is kept.

Generated names use the default order (first part, space, second part): first parts are genitive phrases with የ or invariant adjectives (የነጎድጓድ, ቀይ, መንታ), second parts nouns (ጫፍ, ሸለቆ), so every pair reads naturally (የነጎድጓድ ጫፍ). No generatedNames setting is needed.

Japanese given and family names are transliterated into Ge'ez script (ካይቶ, ታኬዳ); Sensei Hoshi is መምህር ሆሺ; Shinobi, oni and Kage are transliterated (ሺኖቢ, ኦኒ, ካጌ), and the Kage League (የካጌ ሊግ) stays distinct from the Shadow League (የጥላ ሊግ).

Plural messages use one (0 and 1) and other, as Intl.PluralRules("am") gives. Gregorian month names are written as Amharic loanwords (ጃንዋሪ, ኤፕሪል), not Ethiopian months, because birth dates and seasons follow the Gregorian calendar.
Ethiopic script is outside the bundled Latin fonts, so the game needs the device fonts (Noto Sans Ethiopic on Android, Kefa on Apple, Nyala/Ebrima on Windows) when Amharic is activated.
